# Exclusions

```{r}
# Compute group-level means and SDs per Experiment × FeatureMatch
group_stats <- d %>%
  filter(FeatureMatch %in% c("DissimilarControl", "SimilarControl")) %>%
  group_by(Experiment, FeatureMatch) %>%
  summarize(
    group_mean = mean(Response, na.rm = TRUE),
    group_sd   = sd(Response, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Compute participant-level means
participant_means <- d %>%
  filter(FeatureMatch %in% c("DissimilarControl", "SimilarControl")) %>%
  group_by(Experiment, ID.Ibex, FeatureMatch) %>%
  summarize(
    MeanPropSimilar = mean(Response, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Join group means/SDs to participant means
merged <- participant_means %>%
  left_join(group_stats, by = c("Experiment", "FeatureMatch"))

# Identify participants to exclude
to_exclude_justright <- merged %>%
  filter(
    (FeatureMatch == "DissimilarControl" & MeanPropSimilar > (group_mean + group_sd)) |
    (FeatureMatch == "SimilarControl"    & MeanPropSimilar < (group_mean - group_sd))
  ) %>%
  pull(ID.Ibex) %>%
  unique()

# Check exclusion counts
print(length(to_exclude_justright))
length(unique(d$ID.Ibex))
length(to_exclude_justright) / length(unique(d$ID.Ibex))
# Final n = 299
length(unique(d$ID.Ibex)) - length(to_exclude_justright)


```

```{r}
agr <- d %>% 
  filter(!ID.Ibex %in% to_exclude_justright) %>% 
  group_by(Experiment, FeatureMatch) %>% 
  reframe(MeanPropSimilar = mean(Response), 
          SD = sd(Response))

print(agr)
```


```{r}
agr <- d %>% 
  filter(!ID.Ibex %in% to_exclude_justright) %>% 
  group_by(Experiment) %>% 
  reframe(MeanPropSimilar = mean(Response), 
          CILow = ci.low(Response), 
          CIHigh = ci.high(Response)) %>%
  mutate(YMin = MeanPropSimilar - CILow, 
         YMax = MeanPropSimilar + CIHigh)
```

# Wide Graph
```{r}

agr <- d %>% 
  filter(!ID.Ibex %in% to_exclude_justright) %>% 
  group_by(Experiment,FeatureMatch) %>% 
  reframe(MeanPropSimilar = mean(Response), 
          CILow = ci.low(Response), 
          CIHigh = ci.high(Response)) %>%
  mutate(YMin = MeanPropSimilar - CILow, 
         YMax = MeanPropSimilar + CIHigh)
# View(agr)

good_colors <- c(
  "ValenceMatchingOnly" = "#00BFC4",
  "ConceptualMatchingOnly" = "#F8766D",
  "MaxMismatch" = adjustcolor("#F8766D", alpha.f = 0.4),  # lighter via alpha
  "MaxMatch" = adjustcolor("#00BFC4", alpha.f = 0.4),  # lighter via alpha
  "DissimilarControl" = "#818589",
  "SimilarControl" = "#D3D3D3"
)

# Set desired order of legend labels
feature_levels <- c(
  "DissimilarControl",
  "MaxMismatch",
  "ConceptualMatchingOnly",
  "ValenceMatchingOnly",
  "MaxMatch",
  "SimilarControl"
)

# Reorder the factor before plotting
agr <- agr %>%
  mutate(FeatureMatch = factor(FeatureMatch, levels = feature_levels))

dodge = position_dodge(.9)
ggplot(data=agr, aes(x=FeatureMatch,y=MeanPropSimilar, fill=FeatureMatch)) +
  geom_bar(position=dodge,stat="identity") + 
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=YMin,ymax=YMax),width=.25,position=position_dodge(0.9)) +
  facet_wrap(
      ~Experiment,
      ncol=4,
      labeller=label_wrap_gen(width=16)
      ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = good_colors) +
  theme(axis.title.x=element_blank(),
        axis.text.x=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x=element_blank(),
        text = element_text(family = "Helvetica"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),     # y-axis title
        axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 12),     # y-axis ticks
        
        strip.text= element_text(size = 10)    # facet labels
        # legend.position = "none"# legend labels
      )

ggsave("../graphs/simex-wide.pdf", width = 6, height = 3)
# ggsave("../graphs/simex-legend.pdf", width = 7, height = 8)

```

# Violin Plot
```{r}

# Reorder factor and filter participants
d_plot <- d %>%
  filter(!ID.Ibex %in% to_exclude_justright) %>%
  mutate(
    FeatureMatch = factor(FeatureMatch, levels = feature_levels)
  )

ggplot(d_plot, aes(x = FeatureMatch, y = Response, fill = FeatureMatch)) +
  geom_violin(trim = TRUE, alpha = 0.7) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    shape = 21,
    size = 2,
    color = "black",
    fill = "white",
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_cl_normal,
    geom = "errorbar",
    width = 0.2,
    color = "black",
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~Experiment,
    ncol = 2,
    labeller = label_wrap_gen(width = 16)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = good_colors) +
  labs(
    y = "Mean proportion similar",
    x = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12)
  )

```


```{r}
dcen <- d %>% 
  filter(!ID.Ibex %in% to_exclude_justright) %>% 
  filter(FeatureMatch %in% c("ConceptualMatchingOnly","ValenceMatchingOnly")) %>% 
  mutate(WordPair = as.factor(WordPair),
         ID.Ibex = as.factor(ID.Ibex),
         FeatureMatch = as.factor(FeatureMatch),
         Experiment = as.factor(Experiment),
        cResponse = as.numeric(Response)-mean(as.numeric(Response)),
        cFeatureMatch = as.numeric(FeatureMatch)-mean(as.numeric(FeatureMatch)))

m <- lmer(cResponse ~ cFeatureMatch*Experiment + (1|WordPair) + (1+cFeatureMatch|ID.Ibex), data = dcen)
summary(m)
```

```{r}
dval <- d %>%
```
